provenance.training: Participant data.json train only; class-balanced stream of 200 samples. A simulated Izhikevich culture (not living neurons) was settled for 1000 ms and trained with the neurorover frozen rule; a logistic readout was fit to training spike counts.

hyperparameters.culture: simulated Izhikevich culture; 64 electrodes x 16 neurons
hyperparameters.readout: bench.fit_logistic on standardized training spike counts

provenance.pre_event_work: Existing neurorover simulator and benchmark code reused; no external models used.
